_note: Chart package regions. ncds_10..14 keep NOAA's package ids and boxes (from each ncds_<n>.mbtiles 'bounds'), so our packages replace NOAA's May 2024 files in the app as an ordinary update. Exception: ncds_10's east edge is moved from -80.6 to -80.05 so the upper Keys (Key Largo, Card Sound), which fall outside all five NOAA boxes, have an owner. 'zoom_boxes' optionally narrow the box from a zoom upwards (used by the small demonstration regions). Which tiles are rendered inside a box is decided by ENC coverage and scale (policy.py), not by the box alone.

ncds_10.title: Region 10: Southwest Florida and the Keys
ncds_10.summary: Tampa Bay, Sarasota, Charlotte Harbor, Fort Myers and the Caloosahatchee, Naples, the Everglades coast, Florida Bay, and the Keys from Key Largo to Key West and the Dry Tortugas.

ncds_11.title: Region 11: Florida Big Bend to Mississippi Sound
ncds_11.summary: The Gulf coast from Tarpon Springs and the Big Bend to Apalachicola, Panama City, Destin, Pensacola, Mobile Bay and Mississippi Sound to Biloxi.

ncds_12.title: Region 12: New Orleans, Lake Pontchartrain and Mississippi Sound
ncds_12.summary: The Mississippi River from Baton Rouge past New Orleans, Lake Pontchartrain and Lake Borgne, western Mississippi Sound (Gulfport), Morgan City and the Intracoastal Waterway across Louisiana.

ncds_13.title: Region 13: The Mississippi Delta and Louisiana bayous
ncds_13.summary: Louisiana's coast south of 29.33 N: the Mississippi River below Venice and its passes, Barataria Bay and Grand Isle, Terrebonne and Timbalier Bays, and Atchafalaya Bay.

ncds_14.title: Region 14: Texas and western Louisiana
ncds_14.summary: Lake Charles and the Calcasieu, Sabine Pass, Galveston Bay and the Houston Ship Channel, Freeport, Matagorda Bay, Corpus Christi, and the Laguna Madre to Brownsville.

demo_swpass.title: Demo: Mississippi River passes
demo_swpass.summary: Demonstration package: Southwest Pass to Head of Passes at full detail, the Birdfoot delta at mid zooms, the Louisiana coast at low zooms.
